calculation.description: Fades the 10-session return ending ten completed sessions before the signal, scaled by lagged 40-session realized volatility. The signal is fully expressed during broad lagged weakness (fewer than 40% of instruments positive over lagged 20-day returns) and attenuated to 25% otherwise. All inputs are completed observations available before the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: H10 IC by chronological thirds: +0.067705, +0.033884, +0.045717. Broad weakness stress state occurred on 37.35% of dates. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative interpretation of IC uncertainty.
